description: History of calls to the press_tr MCP server. Each tool call and each refused request adds one row. Rows are never edited.
name: PTR MCP Call

fields.label: Tool
fields.description: Name of the MCP tool. A refused request is written as handler.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Preview: nothing changed. Done: the tool ran. Failed: the tool raised an error. Refused: the request was not allowed.

fields.label: Arguments
fields.description: Tool arguments as JSON, cut at 2000 characters.

fields.label: Error
fields.description: Error or refusal reason. Empty when the call succeeded.
